Interface PathVariables

All Superinterfaces:
NamedValues
All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultPathVariables, MatchedPathVariables, RoutePathVariables
public interface PathVariables extends NamedValues
The path variables of the route a request matched: every variable of the URI template of the route, e.g. id of /items/{id}.

A controller method, or a request filter method of a server filter that runs after the request is routed, declares a parameter of this type to read them:

@Get("/items/{id}")
Item item(PathVariables pathVariables) {
    return items.find(pathVariables.getLong("id"));
}

There are accessors for strings and the primitive types, e.g. getLong("id") or findInt("page"), with a default value for a missing variable, e.g. getInt("page", 0), and get(String, Class) and find(String, Class) for any other type, e.g. UUID, or get(String, Argument) and find(String, Argument) for a generic type, e.g. List<Integer> of an exploded variable, or the list accessors getStrings(String), getList(String, Class) and findList(String, Class). Values convert with the conversion service of the route, like the PathVariable arguments of a controller method, and fail the same way: a missing variable or a value that does not convert is answered with 400.

A request is routed after the pre-matching filters ran, so a @PreMatching filter method cannot declare it.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    • getStrings

      default List<String> getStrings(String name)
      The values of a required variable as strings, like a List<String> path variable argument of a controller method: the values of an exploded variable, e.g. of /files{/path*}, or of a comma separated value, split the same way, and a single value is a list of one element. 
      @Get("/tags/{tags}")
List<Post> tagged(PathVariables pathVariables) {
    return posts.tagged(pathVariables.getStrings("tags"));
}
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the variable
      Returns:
      The values
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the variable has no value, answered with 400
      Since:
      5.3.0
